title: 2021 Topps #US61 Marwin González Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps trading card featuring Marwin Gonzalez from the Boston Red Sox in Major League Baseball. This sports trading card is part of the 2021 Topps set manufactured by Topps. It is a single card with the card number US61, showcasing the player Marwin Gonzalez during the 2021 season. Perfect for baseball fans and collectors alike, this trading card captures a moment in baseball history featuring a player from the Boston Red Sox.
